body:
You could also omit the description technically (it won't count for completion), but we have never done that so far.
```suggestion
		<member name="snap" type="float" setter="set_snap" getter="get_snap" default="0.001" deprecated="The CSG library no longer uses snapping.">
			This property does nothing.
```
If it's no longer used why is it passed?

If it does absolutely nothing, why storing on disk with PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR?
```suggestion
#ifndef DISABLE_DEPRECATED
	ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::FLOAT, "snap", PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE, "0.000001,1,0.000001,suffix:m", PROPERTY_USAGE_NONE), "set_snap", "get_snap");
#endif // DISABLE_DEPRECATED
```
Also the corresponding setter and getter should be surrounded with `#ifndef DISABLE_DEPRECATED` as well.
